implemented: Standalone src/physics four-wheel planar Newton–Euler kernel with fixed 5 ms substeps inside 25 ms frames; route controller and UI mode are reserved for 07.2.
Continuous nonlinear constant-mu Dugoff combined-slip brush law, anisotropic friction ellipse, explicit maximum-dissipation locked-wheel branch and inspectable tyre formulas.
Quasi-static drive/brake force commands, front brake split, front/rear/all drive, explicit ideal/disabled/unknown ABS; unknown is never inferred as disabled.
Longitudinal and lateral load transfer, nonnegative loads and wheel-lift flag; low-speed passive impulse limiting, exact substep stop event, reverse and deterministic state continuation.
Measured/reference/synthetic provenance contract; three explicitly selected CommonRoad reference chassis with source hashes and complete BSD license, separate synthetic verification vehicle.
Actor.dynamics schema 1 with strict import validation and no implicit migration/default; actorSpec/dimsOf, existing collision impulses and technical use the same selected mass and planar geometry.
Technical trace records selected parameters, units/provenance and explicitly identifies the still-kinematic scene simulation; kernel trace records every substep and numerical correction.

Independent formula, energy, momentum, braking, steady-turn/understeer-gradient, lateral grip bound, ellipse, dissipation, convergence, reverse and low-speed verification; all legacy presets preserved.
Profile documentation docs/PHYSICS.md, research provenance and README limitations; reproducible Chromium verification script.
limitations: No route/speed controller, env.physics selector, road zones or new parameter editor in 07.1; these are 07.2 responsibilities. simulate() remains kinematic.

Drive is quasi-static: wheel rotational inertia, engine/gearbox transients, brake hydraulics and a real ABS algorithm are not modeled. Ideal ABS is an explicitly synthetic near-asymptote force limiter.
Planar rigid body only: no suspension dynamics, rollover, aerodynamic/rolling resistance, slopes or tyre temperature/load/speed dependence. Wheel lift is flagged, not a validated 3D continuation.

Low-speed slip regularization (0.1 m/s), passive impulse scale and 1e-10 rest threshold are numerical assumptions; load transfer uses previous-substep acceleration and explicit front roll-moment fraction.

Reference chassis are not measured complete vehicles. Tyres/brakes/drive/roll distribution must be supplied with their own sources. Reference OBB/CG offset is synthetic zero; body height retains the legacy class value.

No automatic analogue for pedestrians, two-wheelers, carts, rail, articulated or multi-axle vehicles. Other four-wheel classes require explicit applicable parameter sets; no measured bus/truck catalogue is claimed.
Nonzero separately specified cargo mass is rejected because loaded mass/Iz/CG must be reconciled together.
No natural/field validation. Original Dugoff paper and primary DOT measurements remain unverified; synthetic tests do not close source-check TODOs.
sqrt(mu*g*R) is a purely lateral flat-road force bound, not a rollover limit or a guarantee of following a path under combined braking.

contracts.name: DynamicVehicleParameters / ParameterSource / VehicleBody / DugoffTyres
contracts.notes: SI; schemaVersion=1. body.mass kg, yawInertia kg m², lf/lr/tracks/cgHeight/length/width/bodyCenterOffset m; wheelbase=lf+lr. Per-tyre stiffness N/unit-slip or N/rad. Provenance for each parameter group.

contracts.name: DynamicState
contracts.notes: CG x/y m, heading rad, world vx/vy m/s, yawRate rad/s, prior inertial ax/ay in body axes m/s². Preserve all fields for continuation. Body axes x forward/y right; positive yaw clockwise.

contracts.name: DynamicControl / DynamicRoad
contracts.notes: steering ±pi/3 rad, signed drive [-1,1], brake [0,1]. Simultaneous drive+brake rejected. Road mu>=0 plus source. Unknown ABS permits coasting/drive but braking throws.

contracts.name: stepDynamics
contracts.notes: Pure input-to-output 25 ms frame; default five fixed 5 ms steps, optional fixed divisor 0.1–5 ms. Returns {state, trace?}. No path snapping. trace includes force values before impulseScale and motionSeconds for a stop inside a substep.

contracts.name: evaluateForces / dugoffTyre / lockedTyre / normalLoads / kineticEnergy / understeerGradient / lateralGripSpeed
contracts.notes: Independent verification API without a route controller. Forces in N and moments N m; normalLoads order FL,FR,RL,RR. K uses axle stiffness=2*per-tyre stiffness and units rad/(m/s²).

contracts.name: VEHICLE_REFERENCES / parametersFromReference / syntheticVehicle
contracts.notes: References contain chassis only, not equipment defaults. Factory requires explicit tyres/brakes/drive/loadTransfer. syntheticVehicle returns a fresh synthetic fixture with ABS unknown.

contracts.name: Actor.dynamics / dynamicSupport / initialDynamicState / validateActorDynamics
contracts.notes: Optional schema-1 object, legacy scenes remain version 1 with no added defaults. actorSpec/dimsOf use selected mass/geometry and bodyCenterOffset, collision/technical share them. Invalid imports/classes/cargo rejected; support union gives a reason. initialDynamicState converts signed actor.speed km/h to SI once.

contracts.name: technical trace physicalParameters
contracts.notes: Additive field only for actors with dynamics. Carries actual mass/geometry, parameters and source, with motionMethod='legacy-kinematic'. Does not claim current stopping assessment is dynamic.
